# Records

Machine-readable records live in `spec-records.json` (served by the MCP tool `flop_explain_requirement`).
Committed citations are line-free locators `{path, anchor, span, quote?}`; `flop_explain_requirement` resolves
them against the live files into `{path, anchor, lines, sha256}` at request time, so edits elsewhere in a source do
not rewrite this catalog. `specStatus`, `implementationStatus` (Appendix H only when exactly one row names the key),
and `evidenceStatus` are independent; `unknown` is a valid value.

# Extraction Rules

* R-IDs: `**R<sec>.<n>[a-z]?**` bullets/paragraphs and `| R<sec>.<n>[a-z]? |` table rows.
* Appendix E: `**E.<n> — title` stubs; an E-item named by a decision `**Consequences.**` paragraph as closing is `closed`.
* Decisions: `## D-0xxx` sections plus the index table status; `supersedes` / `would supersede` clauses.
* Appendix H: every table row under an `H.<n>` heading.
* Conflicts: a closure whose Appendix E stub still exists; a Proposal/Draft/pending decision whose effect the yellowpaper states as completed (`withdrawn by`, `D-0xxx withdraws`, ...).
